notes.title: Gravitee v1.1 – five new levels!
notes.notes: [p]Hey there! A big update just came out for Gravitee. Five new levels have been added, which contain never seen before obstacles! New achievements are in the game to go along with them.[/p][p][b]The new levels[/b][/p][p]Level 36, The Narrow Path – creep through an obstacle-filled path filled with deadly traps round every twist and turn. Get the “Steady Hand” achievement by collecting a golden ball located down a thin, spiky corridor![/p][p]Level 37, Minefield – bombs, bombs and more bombs. Explode all of them to get the “Fireworks” achievement![/p][p]Level 38, Eight Little Challenges – this level introduces spiky marbles! Unlike golden marbles, you don’t want to collect these. Get the “Crazy Eight” achievement by completing this level quickly.[/p][p]Level 39, Marble Mayhem – spiky marbles fly about everywhere. Get the “Dodgeball” achievement by completing this level without dying.[/p][p]Level 40, Spinning Around – this level introduces boosters that rotate! Make sure to hit them when they’re pointing you in the right direction.[/p][p][b]Other changes[/b][/p][p]There’s now an achievement for completing level 11 quickly – “Carefree”. Also, the time requirement for the “Speedrun” achievement has been increased by ten minutes to reflect that the game is now longer.[/p][p]Have fun![/p][p]sightafter[/p]

notes.title: Gravitee v1.0.8 - new music!
notes.notes: [p]Hey there,[/p][p]Someone who plays Gravitee - blorbaltude - has got in touch and contributed an awesome new track to the game![/p][p] It's a track specifically for level 18 "One Minute" and is exactly a minute long - it gets more and more intense the closer you get to the bomb exploding![/p][p]Have fun,[/p][p]sightafter[/p]

notes.title: Gravitee v1.0.7 - restart button on pause menu & bug fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there!

Another small update for Gravitee.

There's now a restart button when you pause the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635957/7c3899114f9ee70e1bb8685d23eba26d47e8364e.png"][/img]

A few bugs have been fixed:
- A bug where you could get softlocked on level 13 is fixed.
- When you are using a second monitor, the cursor no longer leaves the game, stopping you from rotating.
- A bug with the "information opens automatically" setting not getting saved is fixed.

Thanks for your bug reports & support so far!

sightafter[/p]

notes.title: Gravitee v1.0.5 - in-game achievement tracker, invert mouse setting & bug fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there!

Here's a small update for Gravitee.

There's now an [b]in-game tracker for achievements[/b]! When you hit pause, you'll be able to see a relevant achievement, and your current progress towards it in the level.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635957/9fd05f06f29eb707fa96bfcfd99cfd5d9e470910.png"][/img]
There's also an [b]invert mouse[/b] option in the settings now.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635957/a70725baf6aa006cd3b4af7c7f0d279e44e9d0e8.png"][/img][/p][p]This version also fixed a bug where the achievement "Controlled Demolition" wouldn't work.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun!

sightafter[/p]
